source: github.com/genshinsim/gcsim at gcsim_commit — internal/characters/<key>/*.go (AGPL-3.0; MIT for code before 2026-09-19)
note: Elemental Skill particles per cast for the formula estimate's energy model (DESIGN_team_math_fallback.md §2.11, TASKS 14). Each count is read off the QueueParticle call it cites; `lines` names each cited line and a substring it must contain, and tests/unit/test_formula_energy_data.py holds every entry to the committed snapshot of those lines (gcsim_lines.json, scripts/gcsim/snapshot_particle_lines.py). A random count is its expectation (2 + 0.25 for Bennett's tap). `collector` says who catches the particles: `caster` lands them while the caster is still on field (a teammate's are caught off field), `active` is an off-field generator whose particles the on-field character catches. A summon whose particles come with a chance per hit (Raiden's Eye, Oz, Kuki's ring, Kokomi's jellyfish, Zhongli's stele) carries `chance` (the literal on its `Rand` line) and a hit cadence (`interval`, `max_seconds`), each cited to gcsim and to KQM; `particles` is chance x particles per hit. `on: burst` counts a source once per burst rather than per skill cast (Oz from Fischl's burst). `refunds` are flat energy (gcsim `AddEnergy`, never multiplied by ER): `per` burst or cast, `count` a trigger, `amount` (or `amount_row`, a talent row in our catalogue at the build's level), `recipients` team or self, `scaling` none, per_er (x the giver's ER) or raiden_a4 (x 1 + 0.006 x whole percent of ER above 100%). `weapons.favonius` is the Favonius proc (chance and cooldown from the catalogue's refinement row). `shared_icd: true` says the particle ICD is shared by every summon of the source (Yae's totems), so skill casts do not multiply it. `resonances.electro` is Electro resonance's particle (one a qualifying reaction, a cooldown, the team elements that can react with Electro). `not_curated` names characters left to the user, and why; it is empty since Yae was curated at gcsim's rate (DESIGN_team_math_fallback.md §2.11, DECISIONS.md §48-49). Since the small calls (DECISIONS.md §50): `resonances.electro.default_procs_per_second` is the default proc rate, read off the committed samples it names; a refund's `recipients` may also be `others` (every member but the giver), `active` (whoever is on field) or `absorbed` (every member of the element Venti's burst absorbed, `absorbs` being gcsim's order); `per: second` refunds run every `interval` seconds, for `max_seconds` after a cast or burst (`on`), or the whole fight (`on: rotation`). `constellation_refunds` holds every constellation `AddEnergy` at the pin, each with `requires_constellation` (a build below it is not served it) and `basis`: `kit` (counted), `assumption` (a toggle, off by default, `condition` stating the assumption) or `fight` (listed, never counted, `condition` saying why). `uncurated_add_energy` names every other `AddEnergy` call at the pin and why it is not curated; tests/unit/test_formula_energy_small_calls.py holds the inventory (gcsim_lines.json `add_energy`) to the two.

sources.label: Sesshou Sakura (lightning strikes)
sources.note: gcsim's rate (owner ruling 2026-11-15): one particle on a totem's strike, with a 2.5 s particle ICD shared by all her totems, and each totem strikes every 176 frames (2.93 s). The ICD is shorter than a totem's own cadence, so one totem drops a particle on every strike, and more totems standing together add none: one every 2.93 s while totems stand, however many there are (a native gcsim run at the pin: one totem and three both drop one every 176 frames). Totems last 25 s at the pin (15 s, and 10 s more from Edict of Cleansing, on by default in gcsim and ungated in the game data), so skill casts do not multiply this source. KQM's library disagrees: it says only each totem's first strike drops one (about 3 for a triple cast), against gcsim's 8 for a totem set at full length.

refunds.label: C2: 1 flat energy, 4 times a skill cast
refunds.note: each Shooting Star that hits; stars fire in a volley of 4 once Night Stars reach 4 (+1 per 1.5 s while her shield exists, +2 on any party member's skill cast while the shield exists, +1 per burst hit)
refunds.condition: Solo baseline of one volley per cast: shield 12 s (skill.go:53), first tick star-less, then +1 star per 90 f (shield.go:204) gives 4 stars at ~379 f and 4 shots; the post-volley restart reaches only 3 stars before the shield ends. 4 Energy per cast; teammate skills (skill.go:84), burst hits (burst.go:69) and C6's 72 f interval (shield.go:206) add more.

refunds.label: C4: 8 flat energy, every 5 s of the rotation
refunds.note: any Sesshou Sakura tick hitting an enemy, with revelation on; 5 s ICD shared across all her Sakuras (character status)
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Assumes a Sakura is up and hitting the whole time. The ICD is 5 s (cons.go:211) and each Sakura lives 900 f + 600 f revelation bonus − skillStart (kitsune.go:13,39; stellar.go:51). One Sakura ticks every 176 f (kitsune.go:166), so a single Sakura fires every 352 f (~5.9 s); overlapping Sakuras approach the 5 s ICD.

refunds.label: C1: 8 flat energy, 3 times a burst
refunds.note: burst: one Tenko Thunderbolt per Sesshou Sakura present at cast; each grants 8 energy at its thunderbolt time (154 + i*24 frames after cast)
refunds.condition: Assuming 3 Sakuras are up at burst (the cap: kitsune.go pops the oldest when a 4th would be placed, and skill has 3 charges), it fires 3 times = 24 energy per burst.

refunds.label: C4: 2 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: each A1 Rehab Diet healing tick after her burst that crits (Rand <= her CRIT Rate), up to 7 per burst; C4 also extends the ticks from 9 to 15
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Expected value per burst = 2 x E[min(Binomial(15, CR), 7)]: 9+6 ticks (asc.go:13,26; cons.go:20), each refunding with probability CRIT Rate (cons.go:171), capped at c4Limit=7 (cons.go:22,175).

refunds.label: C6: 3 flat energy, 6 times a burst
refunds.note: the first sword of every 5-sword wave (every third wave: 2 -> 3 -> 5 at C6) hitting an enemy; waves fire when the active character is in Normal Attack state during the burst, at most once per 60 f
refunds.condition: Upper bound at maximum wave rate: burst 18 s at C6 (C2 +3 s, burst.go:49-51); the wave ICD is 60 f (xingqiu.go:39), so at most 18 waves, every third a 5-sword wave (burst.go:144-158) = 6 x 3 = 18 Energy, if the on-field character normal-attacks throughout.

refunds.label: C4: 1.2 flat energy, every 2 s of the rotation
refunds.note: Sayu's own attack triggering a Swirl (Cryo/Electro/Hydro/Pyro or Stellar Swirl) on an enemy while she is the active character; 2 s ICD shared with her A1 heal
refunds.condition: Needs an elemental aura on the enemy from teammates (OnSwirl* events, asc.go:51-53) and Sayu on field (asc.go:29), and nothing in the kit bounds how long she swirls on field, so there is no cited duration to multiply the 2 s interval (asc.go:35) by.

refunds.label: C1: 15 flat energy, every 18 s of the rotation
refunds.note: any party member (any attacker) triggers an Electro-related reaction on an enemy: Overload, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Electro Swirl, Electro Crystallize, Hyperbloom, Quicken or Aggravate; 18 s ICD
refunds.condition: Assuming an Electro-related reaction lands on an enemy at least every 18 s, it fires once per 18 s ICD window (cons.go:32 sets an 18*60 frame ICD); there is no duration bound, the hook is subscribed for the whole fight (cons.go:36-45).

refunds.label: C4: 9 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: burst: the first enemy tagged by the Windmuster Iris aura-check attack (queued at burstHitmark = 34 frames after cast) calls c4(1). c4 is called in the aura-check callback BEFORE irisDmg checks for a Hydro/Pyro/Electro/Cryo aura (burst.go:39 then 41; irisDmg returns early at burst.go:120-126 if no aura), so in gcsim the 9 energy is granted whenever the burst's aura-check hits an enemy, even with no elemental aura and no Iris explosion. The in-game text ties it to the Iris explosion; gcsim does not. Energy is consumed at frame 3, refund lands at frame 34, i.e. after consumption.

refunds.label: C4: 1.5 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: burst: the 2nd, 3rd and 4th distinct enemies tagged by the aura-check attack each call c4(2..4)
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Fires (enemies hit by the aura check - 1) times, capped at 3 by the 4-tag cap (burst.go:33); a single-target estimate gives 0 triggers.

refunds.label: C2: 6 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: once per burst cast, task queued 9 frames after cast
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Amount depends on team composition: c2GeoMemberCount counts every Geo character in Chars() including Itto, capped at 3 (itto.go Init), so a Itto-only-Geo team gets 6 and a mono-Geo team 18.

refunds.label: C2: 25 flat energy to every other member, a skill cast
refunds.note: when Xilonen's Nightsoul points reach max (90) from A1 point generation (+35 per Nightsoul roller NA / plunge hit, 0.1 s ICD) while samplersConverted >= 2: a1MaxPoints -> c2activate grants 25 to each Electro member
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Requires A1, at least 2 Pyro/Hydro/Cryo/Electro teammates (a1cb returns if samplersConverted < 2) and at least one Electro teammate; assuming Xilonen does roller NAs after her skill (she enters with 45 points, two +35 hits reach 90), it fires once per skill cast because max points consumes all points (asc.go:74) and a1cb needs points > 0.

refunds.label: C2: 2 flat energy, a skill cast
refunds.note: on the skill re-press that detonates Pressurized Floe (Shattering Pressure), once per skill cycle
refunds.condition: Assuming the skill is re-pressed to detonate within the 10 s Persistence window (skill.go sets persTimeKey 10*60; c2 is only called from detonateSkill), it fires once per skill cycle for 2 energy, or 3 if 4 Pressure stacks were built from Cryo NAs (attack.go caps stacks at 4).

refunds.label: C1: 15 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: once per burst cast, when the Drunken Mist field ends: task queued burstStart+750 = 808 frames after cast. Unconditional: no hit, aura or on-field requirement. Lands ~13.5 s after cast, well after energy consumption at frame 43 and inside the 20 s burst CD (burst.go:87 SetCDWithDelay 1200).

refunds.label: C4: 4 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: burst: each robot, when it absorbs an element from an enemy aura (Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo) in its area, calls c4 once; robots only spawn if Moonsign level >= 2
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Assuming Moonsign level >= 2 (burst.go:120) and an enemy with an absorbable aura during the burst, each of the 2 robots (burst.go:75; +1 if A1's next-highest element is Electro, asc.go:73) absorbs once, giving 2 triggers = 8 energy per burst.

refunds.label: C4: 2 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: Chongyun's own NA, skill, A4 blade or burst blade hits an enemy that has Cryo aura (checked after the hit's element is applied) while Chongyun is the active character; 2 s ICD
refunds.condition: The callback is attached to all three burst blades (burst.go:40-50, hitmarks 50/59/67, inside one 2 s ICD window) and each blade applies 25 Cryo, so assuming Chongyun is on field and the Cryo is not consumed by a reaction, it fires once per burst; it can also fire on skill/NA hits, which are not counted here.

refunds.label: C1: 6 flat energy, a skill cast
refunds.note: a Nightsoul-state Tonicshot (tap NA or hold CA during skill state) hits; 8 s ICD
refunds.condition: Assuming Ifa fires at least one Tonicshot in each skill state, it fires once per skill cast; Nightsoul starts at 80 points draining 8/s (skill.go:67, 94-101), at most ~10 s, so a second proc 8 s later in the same cast is possible but not counted.

refunds.label: C1: 1.2 flat energy, every 2 s for 30 s a skill
refunds.note: each Transient Blossom: any party member's non-zero damage on an enemy inside the Solar Isotoma area, excluding the skill's initial hit, while the construct exists; 2 s ICD
refunds.condition: Assuming the team damages an enemy in the field continuously, a Blossom procs every 2 s (skill.go:129, 120 frames, not hitlag-extended) over the construct's 30 s life (skill.go:68 newConstruct(1800,...)), i.e. up to 15 procs per skill cast.

refunds.label: C1: 2 flat energy, a skill cast
refunds.note: callback on Prune's swirl-dependent attacks hitting an enemy: the skill recast (convert) hit, A1 swirl follow-up hits from the burst bell, and C4 ricochets; 1.8 s ICD
refunds.condition: Assuming the initial skill swirls an aura and Prune recasts within the window (skill.go sets skillRecastWindowKey 364 on swirl), the convert hit procs it once per skill cast; burst A1 procs need further swirls by the bell and are not counted.

refunds.label: C4: 10 flat energy, a skill cast
refunds.note: either of the skill's two hits (15 and 33 frames after cast) hits an enemy; 10 s ICD. ICD equals the skill CD (both 600 frames). The ICD is set at the first hit (~frame 15) and is hitlag-extendable, the CD starts at frame 13; recasting on exact CD puts the next first hit ~frame 628 vs ICD expiry ~615 plus any hitlag on Aino, so it should fire every cast, but heavy hitlag could in principle make a back-to-back cast miss. Second hit of the same cast is blocked by the ICD.

refunds.label: C1: 2.5 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: each Benison stack gained during Favonian Favor: 1 stack per 4 Normal Attack hits by the active character (0.05 s ICD between counted hits), or 2 stacks when a Favored character triggers Frozen (A1, 8 s ICD); max 4 stacks generated per burst
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Assuming the active character lands 16 NA hits during the 12 s Favonian Favor (or Frozen procs), the 4-stack generation cap (burst.go benisonMaxGenerate = 4, reset each burst) is reached, giving 4 stacks = 10 energy per burst.

refunds.label: C1: 8 flat energy, every 5.5 s of the rotation
refunds.note: any Lunar-Charged reaction triggered on an enemy (by anyone; OnLunarCharged is emitted per triggering Hydro/Electro application in pkg/reactable/lunarcharged.go); 5.5 s ICD
refunds.condition: Assuming Lunar-Charged is triggered at least every 5.5 s, it fires once per 5.5 s ICD (cons.go:35); subscribed for the whole fight (cons.go:26), not tied to burst or skill.

refunds.label: C4: 20 flat energy, per trigger
refunds.note: another character carrying the Together We Rise (c1RevKey) buff triggers an Electro-related reaction on an enemy; 18 s ICD; only with the revelation param (default on)
refunds.condition: The buff on another character exists only if Cyno entered Pactsworn in Stellar Radiance (Polestar field, stellar.go isStellarRadiance) with C1 and then swapped out mid-burst passing the buff on (cons.go:58-71), and that character must then trigger an Electro reaction (cons.go:228-238); no kit-only assumption makes that countable.

refunds.label: C4: 3 flat energy to every other member, a burst
refunds.note: Cyno himself triggers Overload, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom or Electro Swirl on an enemy; max 5 times, counter reset on each burst cast
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Assuming Cyno triggers at least 5 Electro reactions per burst, the 5-instance cap (cons.go:241 'counting from 0 to 4, 5 instances max', reset at burst.go c4Counter = 0) gives 5 triggers = 15 energy to each other party member per burst.

refunds.label: C4: 3 flat energy, a burst
refunds.note: each Eagleplume heal: the active character's Normal Attack damages an enemy during the 15 s Eagleplume state, with a 2.5 s per-character heal ICD (shortened by the skill's ATK SPD buff); max 5 per burst
refunds.condition: No count the energy model can read per burst or skill cast; enter it as flat energy. Assuming the active character keeps Normal-Attacking through Eagleplume, the 15 s state (burst.go:42) holds at least 6 heal windows at the 2.5 s ICD (mika.go healIcd = 2.5*60), so the cap of 5 (burst.go:40 c4Count = 5) is reached: 15 energy per burst.

refunds.label: C4: 5 flat energy, per trigger
refunds.note: every Lunar-Charged reaction triggered on an enemy by anyone (OnLunarCharged, emitted per triggering application); gcsim sets a 4 s ICD status but never checks it
refunds.condition: cons.go:141 adds c4IcdKey (4*60) but nothing reads it (no StatusIsActive check before cons.go:140), so in gcsim it fires on every Lunar-Charged trigger with no cap, and the count depends entirely on how many Hydro/Electro applications the team lands.

favonius.note: On a crit by the wielder while the wielder is the active character, a chance (refinement param 0) to drop 3 clear particles, then a cooldown (refinement param 1, seconds). Chance and cooldown are read from the weapon's refinement row in our catalogue; gcsim computes the same from the refinement (0.5 + 0.1 R, 810 - 90 R frames).
favonius.kqm: library.keqingmains.com/combat-mechanics/energy — "3 Clear Elemental Particles are generated when the passive procs"; "Refinements only change the frequency of Particles produced, not the amount of Particles."

electro.name: High Voltage
electro.default_note: Default procs: 3 per 25 s rotation, 0.12 a second, as gcsim's two committed Raiden-team samples proc at the pin (summon_energy_sample.json: Raiden, Fischl, Kokomi, Zhongli; electro_res_sample.json: Raiden, Fischl, Xingqiu, Bennett): 3 between each pair of Raiden's bursts, 1500-1518 frames apart, in both, against the 5 the cooldown allows. A rate, so a longer rotation counts more, and never more than one every 5 s. Owner ruling 2026-11-15 (DECISIONS.md §50).
electro.note: In a party of four with two or more Electro members, an Electro reaction on an enemy distributes one Electro particle to the team at once (no landing delay), at most once every 300 frames (5 s). gcsim triggers it on Overloaded (Pyro), Superconduct and its Stellar-Conduct form (Cryo), Electro-Charged and Lunar-Charged (Hydro), and Quicken, Aggravate and Hyperbloom (Dendro), so a team can trigger it only with a Pyro, Cryo, Hydro or Dendro member. KQM's resonance table names Superconduct, Overloaded and Electro-Charged, and Swirl onto Electro; gcsim, the oracle here, adds the Dendro reactions and not Swirl.
electro.kqm: library.keqingmains.com/combat-mechanics/elemental-effects/elemental-resonance — High Voltage: "Superconduct, Overloaded, and Electro-Charged have a 100% chance to generate an Electro Elemental Particle (CD: 5s)."
